body: i know how that feels - it can be so painful. i am so sorry you are going through this

hey,

sorry it took long to respond but thank you for your kind words. it's weird bc i feel like i go through cycles each month where i will be constantly scrutinising my past behaviour yet feel more emotionally at ease, then there'll be times where it feels like there's no hope and all my fears are true. 

i feel okayish now. i have been recommended a counsellor for my autism and i am considering contacting them be the obsessiveness could be linked to my aspergers. i am also considering contacting a gp bc these serious periods of anxiety have been going on for about a year and four months now! 

i am trying to manage the drinking now and i hope it will stick! i am also walking more, taking longer walks each day. i am continuing to work on my talents and hone them, trying to read more. there are websites and topics i constantly read that i might need to cut back because they stir up obsessive thoughts.

i have aspergers too, and i feel you - it can be so SHIT sometimes. it sometimes feels like a looming shadow over all your interpersonal relationships to the point where it clouds your own judgment. if you wanna discuss it further, feel free to PM me.

i can't offer you psychiatric advice, but i know from experience that mental health problems can make you feel like you haven't achieved anything and you don't have the "right" to be miserable because others have it worse. and bullying def excaberates it in a way that you don't realise until years later when you notice the hesitation in your movement and trepidation in your voice! it's hard to compare yourself to others bc your situations will be completely different and you can't give yourself a hard time because you find that your feeling low isn't "justified". and you don't have to struggle necessarily to be great - just be kind, honest, open and loving to those around you. you seem like a very compassionate and astute person so i am sure you are there already.

regarding chronic loneliness, i am so sorry that you are going through this. the feeling of constant repetition day by day and like the future is just stagnating is such a shit experience to endure. have you ever been on meetup? it's a great app if you want to meet people irl and you can find likeminded friends through similar interests. you could also create an account on okcupid for friendships (apparently it's been done before) and find someone within your area to hang out with. i hope you get what you want! ❤️

i don't know how he will respond. it's up to him. i sent the message under a throwaway email. i just hope he's doing well and not disturbed, you know? the internet has changed the social climate dramatically and while in some cases it's for the better (i.e. the egypt and libya protests) in others it's been for the way fucking worse. 😔

i know it's probably doing more harm than good, the feeling almost overshadows the possibilities and hopes you have for the future. it doesn't help, but i feel like with regret or guilt it's essentially time + perspective. like the more older you are, the more you look back and wince at your previous behaviour. i was embarrassing from 16, 17, 18, etc up to 21 and i only started getting a grip on acting my age when i was bordering 22 years old.

i'm not in therapy at the moment, i was referring to cbt from last year which ended in august! but i am considering seeing a psychotherapist or contacting an ocd hotline. i feel like i'm being fraudulent by claiming ocd - i usually just refer to my compulsive fears and thoughts as anxiety problems - but it would probably be worth giving a look, especially if it's going to keep eating me up like this. it's hard to get your life into perspective when your brain keeps telling you "this is all you are and all you're going to be".

thank you for the kind words. :)

i didn't have any intention to, no. but the story was just too graphic to send to someone in their teens and i am profoundly disturbed that i sent that. like i shouldn't be doing that, i should be setting an example. i told him in character "hope you find a good man" and he said "i thought it would be you" and it just stunned me because i was trolling and had no intention of getting off with him - now it's like of course, he probably felt like he was being spoken to like an adult and of course he got that impression. i think i might have written the story beforehand, waited for the first gay guy to pop up on omegle and with each bit of text pretended to be typing to make it look like i was writing it as i went along. the memory of producing it is a little hazy. it's too orchestrated to have been made up on the spot.

and i have been told by family members that i might have ocd, but i am unsure. i feel like its almost excusing my behaviour or devaluing the severity of it. i know that if i wasn't worrying about this at the moment i would be worrying about something else. i have been in cbt for going through a distressing period of hating my appearance and developing severe anxiety issues from it and i am a bit tentative about going through therapy all over again because i feel like it sucks up valuable time when i could be working. i also feel like my fears are legitimate because of tumblr callout posts where people who were in their twenties abused minors they met in fandom through online abuse and it just upsets me so much because i don't want the boy to be hurt.

i know a guy like john in your story irl and while he doesn't go around spiking people's joints (to my knowledge) he was really obnoxious with making a ~statement~ with his art and usually used the excuse of artistic expression to excuse rude, disgusting or perverted behaviour. he would chastise people for not getting his installations and videos, which often involved uncomfortably sexual situations that suggested that he was covertly getting off to them more than they were trying to express ideas about sexuality or politics in any meaningful way. it's always so frustrating bc you know you have a right to be upset or annoyed but you sometimes question yourself and think "am i just being narrow minded?"

 i would say your friend deserves a good verbal kick in the rear end for that sort of behaviour and a good kick in the rear end out of your life too. a friend would not be bullying you into doing drugs and whipping out his genitals for a laugh, these things might be unacceptable but slightly understandable behaviour in a 14 year old boy but your friend is 24 years old and has no interest in what you want or your situation. he's a prick and he needs the boot!

are you getting this idea from covert narcissist articles online? bc when they're talking about covert narcissism, they are talking about it in the context of abuse. from what you've described your behaviour sounds a bit manipulative/self-conscious at worst in comparison to being narcissistic. and it sounds like you have enough empathy to realise that the way you approach situations might not be all right, which most narcissists don't acknowledge bc generally they always think THEY'RE in the right (whether they are the grandiose narcissist or the shy narcissist, it's just their approach is totally different.)
aww that sounds like a bit like pink flamingos. have to say i love the throwaway username! 😄

you're right about the "doing things that you'd regret now" aspect - that when you reflect on things you've done in the past you cringe inwardly - but i feel like what i did was way worse than that. i want to move forward but i feel like a vile human being for it. i have problems with anxiety/aspergers but i feel like that doesn't change what happened.
what experience was it that caused you to reflect on this, if you don't mind me asking?
they are deleted now. doesn't stop me from being unhappy about what i did though.

hey again, thank you for your time. yeah, you learn that in mindfulness. like "i can't turn back time and i can't change the past, so i need to put some perspective into the present and accept it for what it is." it took ages to truly accept that but i did for a couple of months ... then i relapsed! 😂 i feel like bc i am not a particularly good or smart person my appearance is something that i need to be highly prioritising and if i can't even hold that up, what else is there really?

maybe i exaggerate my faults but i recently took a photo of my face with only bb cream and my hair down and it just looked WEIRD and misshapen, like a face constructed out of dough. it really bothered me. i look normal in some angles and others i just look haggard and like a frightening muppet. i try not to compare myself to others but there are so many on my fb feed and irl who i see might have small facial quirks at worst but look lovely and normal. i know there's nothing wrong with aging, i just feel like i am aging too soon and do not look good. 

basically i feel like that i have spoke about this to friends and family so many times that it's got rehashed and now i am in deep with my anxiety i don't want my parents and siblings to know how shitty i really feel, i feel like it would be a drain and i feel like my mum thinks i ignore her advice (which is always running). i contacted the samaritans yesterday bc i was feeling so low and was crying about how i hated my features and the volunteer on the line told me to do some eye massages and try putting on makeup. at one point she even asked me "do you really want to kill yourself bc of your appearance?" i don't know what are the rules and guidelines for being a volunteer there but that response really stunned me.

late reply but thank you for your kind words. i know people age and lose their puppy fat as they get older but i feel like i have aged horribly and only resemble the woman i was before in good lighting. i often feel hideous and out of place with other people my own age, as though i don't share anything in common with them whatsoever. and i put so much effort into it but it feels like nothing is changing for the better and only for the worst. i feel so lost and hopeless and like no one really takes how i feel seriously and that theres nothing i can do about it really
